excluded.manipulation: too broad to be a capability

caveats: RoboChallenge tags overlap, so capability groups are overlapping sets rather than a partition -- a model's capability scores do not average back to its suite score.
Tags are each benchmark's own. We pool them; we do not relabel tasks.
Group sizes are uneven, so intervals differ sharply in width between capabilities. That is the measurement, not a defect.
Embodiment tags (single-arm, ALOHA, ARX5...) are excluded: they say where a task runs, not what it tests.
